# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `soundlink` MCP server pointing at Soundlink's hosted endpoint (`https://api.getsoundlink.com/mcp`).
- Logo references Soundlink's hosted `logo-bimi.svg`; getsoundlink.com could not be reached when this plugin was added, so no local copy is committed yet.
